accuracy_rerun.direction_check: All six ward x phase sim means moved TOWARD the observed LST (dc-urs-inputs lstDayC/lstNightC): day errors +9.50/+9.42/+7.52 -> +9.13/+8.74/+7.39 K, night +5.15/+5.12/+4.56 -> +4.96/+4.78/+4.49 K. Caveat: the observed values are ward-invariant regional figures, so this is movement toward the observed LEVEL, not per-ward pattern validation. The large absolute day offsets are the canonical-forcing vs mean-overpass condition mismatch, already documented -- the DELTA is the signal here, and it points the right way everywhere.
